breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and also periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect periodic condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly removed the periodic boundary condition, only stating the Dirichlet condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
